integrity: Exact graph enumeration, acyclic discrete-Morse matching, integer signed boundary with 13 unit columns, primitive 3-cycle, signed 42-element character, and independent GF(2) homology are supplied in a standalone checker.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary 16-cut complex of the squared 21-cycle is classified; no proof for all k, no integral quotient classification, no integral dihedral lattice or independent external validation.
title: A full dihedral character at the first unverified squared-cycle cut complex
